result.summary: Retain the explicit Jinja environment: this change moves XSS protection onto a deprecated configuration path.

findings.title: XSS protection now depends on deprecated environment options
findings.body: The explicit Jinja autoescape setting is replaced with Starlette's deprecated **env_options forwarding. The installed implementation emits a DeprecationWarning; a rendering probe confirms escaping still works today. However, pyproject.toml leaves FastAPI unbounded and Docker installs without uv.lock, so the security configuration now depends on continued support for that deprecated path. If escaping lapses, values rendered in partials/search_log.html:19 and partials/log_viewer.html:21 can become executable HTML. This is a protection durability regression, not a demonstrated current XSS exploit.
findings.recommendation: Restore the preconfigured jinja2.Environment(autoescape=True) and pass it through Jinja2Templates(env=...), the supported replacement explicitly recommended by the installed Starlette implementation.

next_steps: Restore explicit environment configuration and verify that an HTML payload renders escaped.
